content: For pregnant patients diagnosed with diabetes, particularly those undergoing insulin therapy, the use of real-time continuous glucose monitoring (rtCGM) has demonstrated substantial benefits. Clinical studies have shown that rtCGM can lead to improved Time in Range (TIR) and better hemoglobin A1C levels, which are critical for minimizing complications during pregnancy. However, some reports have highlighted an increased occurrence of hypoglycemic episodes associated with rtCGM use. This necessitates careful monitoring and individualized adjustments to the therapeutic approach to ensure optimal outcomes.
